changedAt.description: When the consent base was last changed. ISO 8601 date format

consentCode.description: Consent code used to identify the consent base

consentOwnerOrgId.description: The organisation that owns the consent base. If not set, the consent base can be used by all organisations.

createdAt.description: When the consent base was created. ISO 8601 date format

internalDescription.description: Internal description, describing the use cases for the consent base

orgNameSubstitutionPattern.description: The pattern on which to perform substitution within terms. Facilitates reusable consent basess across organisations

terms.description: Consent terms with long and short description in multiple languages. The descriptions can contain MarkDown

validFrom.description: If set, the date the consent base is valid from. It is not possible to change the consent terms after this date without creating a new version. If not set, the consent base is in draft mode.

validTo.description: If set, the date the consent base is valid to. If this date is in the past, the consent base is deactivated. If not set, the consent is active from validFrom and onwards.

fullDescription.description: Text describing the terms in detail. The text can contain MarkDown

shortDescription.description: Short text explaining the terms. The text can contain MarkDown

ConsentTermsResponse.description: Text for terms in a specific language

description.description: A description for the partner administrating consents

InternalDescriptionResponse.description: Contains internal description for a consent. Will not be shown to customer
